Package sc.fiji.snt.gui

Record Class GuiUtils.ChoiceAction

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
sc.fiji.snt.gui.GuiUtils.ChoiceAction
Record Components:
label - the button label
icon - the button icon (can be null)
tooltip - the button tooltip (can be null)
doneLabel - the label shown after the button is pressed (e.g., "Copied"), until the selection changes. Null to keep label
enabled - tests whether the button is enabled for the choice at the given index
run - the action, given the index of the selected choice
Enclosing class:
GuiUtils
public static record GuiUtils.ChoiceAction(String label, Icon icon, String tooltip, String doneLabel, IntPredicate enabled, IntConsumer run) extends Record
A button displayed below the description of the selected choice of GuiUtils.getChoice(String, String, String[], String[], String, BiFunction, List)
